description: Fetch the column schema for a CDC dataset — names, data types, descriptions, row count, last-updated timestamp, and, for a filter, the dataset it is a view of — with the period and area it covers, how often it is updated, its suggested citation, license, and attribution wherever the publisher recorded them. A chart or map has no schema of its own; the failure names the dataset it is built on. Returns the first 100 columns by default; wide datasets continue via column_offset. The dataset description is capped at 4,000 characters by default; pass full_description: true for the whole text. Get dataset IDs from cdc_discover_datasets.

column_limit.description: Columns to return in this call (default 100). Every dataset under the default arrives whole; past it the response reports totalCount and a nextOffset to pass back as column_offset. Raise this to pull a wide schema in one call — a value at or above the column count returns every column.

column_offset.description: Index of the first column to return, for continuing past a previous call (default 0). Columns keep the order the dataset declares, so column_offset plus column_limit walks the schema without gaps or repeats. An offset at or past the column count returns an empty window rather than an error.

datasetId.description: Four-by-four dataset identifier (e.g., "bi63-dtpu"). Obtain from cdc_discover_datasets.

domain.description: CDC Socrata host to fetch the dataset from. "data.cdc.gov" (default) and "chronicdata.cdc.gov" front the same catalog, so a four-by-four ID resolves on either and the default works whichever host the dataset was found on.

full_description.description: Return the dataset description whole (default false). By default a description longer than 4,000 characters is cut there, and the response sets descriptionTruncated and descriptionLength. Column descriptions are never shortened either way.

name: cdc_get_dataset_schema

attribution.description: The office the publisher credits for the dataset — publisher-written text in no fixed format ("National Center for Health Statistics"). Absent when the publisher recorded none.

cap.description: The column_limit that bounded this response.

citation.description: How the publisher asks the dataset to be cited — publisher-written text in no fixed format, placeholders such as "[Last accessed date]" included. Absent when the publisher recorded none.

columns.description: The requested window of dataset columns, with full types and descriptions. Bounded by column_limit/column_offset; the enrichment fields say how the window sits in the whole schema.

items.description: A single column in the dataset schema.

dataType.description: Column data type (text, number, calendar_date, etc.).

fieldName.description: Column field name (use in SoQL queries).

description.description: Dataset description when provided, as plain text — markup stripped and entity references decoded. Capped at 4,000 characters by default and ending in "…" when cut, with descriptionTruncated and descriptionLength set; pass full_description: true for the whole text. Column descriptions are never shortened.

descriptionLength.description: Character count of the whole description, present only when description was cut. Call again with full_description: true to read all of it.

descriptionTruncated.description: True when description was cut at the 4,000-character cap. Absent means description is the whole text.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `dataset_not_found`: Dataset ID does not exist or has been retired. `not_queryable`: The ID names a catalog asset with no columns — a chart, map, story, file, or external link rather than a tabular dataset. `access_denied`: Socrata returned 403 — the asset is not readable through this endpoint or access is restricted. `invalid_query`: Socrata rejected the metadata request with a 400. `rate_limited`: Socrata API returns 429 Too Many Requests. `upstream_error`: Socrata metadata API returned a 5xx server error, could not be reached, did not finish answering within 20 seconds, or answered with a body that is not the JSON it serves. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

geographicCoverage.description: Area the data covers — publisher-written text in no fixed format ("United States", "50 states and District of Columbia"). Absent when the publisher recorded none.

license.description: Name of the license the dataset is published under — publisher-written text in no fixed format ("Public Domain U.S. Government", "Open Data Commons Attribution License"). Absent when the publisher named none.

name.description: Dataset display name from the catalog (e.g., "Provisional COVID-19 Deaths by Sex and Age").

nextOffset.description: Value to pass as column_offset on the next call to continue after the last column returned. Present only when columns remain beyond this window.

notice.description: Guidance when the response is a subset of the schema — which columns it covers, how to reach the rest, or that column_offset ran past the end.

parentId.description: Four-by-four ID of the dataset this asset is a view of — set on a filter, naming the dataset it was derived from. Absent on a dataset in its own right.

rowCount.description: Total rows in the dataset; omitted when neither a live nor a cached figure is available. Read rowCountSource before sizing a pagination walk against it — the cached figure can understate an actively-updated dataset by a third or more.

rowCountSource.description: Provenance of rowCount. "live" is a count(*) run against the dataset for this call. "cached" is the figure Socrata stored when it last built its column cache, returned when the count request did not succeed; Socrata does not refresh it as rows land. Absent exactly when rowCount is absent.

shown.description: Number of columns returned in this response.

temporalCoverage.description: Period the data covers — publisher-written text in no fixed format, relayed as written ("2015-01-01/2026-05-31", "1999/2018", "2019/present", "N/A"). Absent when the publisher recorded none.

totalCount.description: Total columns in the dataset schema, before column_limit/column_offset.

truncated.description: True when the returned columns are a subset of the schema. Absent means every column of the dataset is in this response.

updateFrequency.description: How often the publisher updates the dataset — publisher-written text in no fixed format ("R/P1M", "Weekly", "irregular", "No longer updated (dataset archived)"). Absent when the publisher recorded none; updatedAt is when the data last changed, which alone does not tell a monthly series from a closed one.

updatedAt.description: Last data update timestamp when provided.

title: Cdc Get Dataset Schema
